title: 污水管渠硫化氫腐蝕控制
summary: 本課以硫化物生成、逸散、腐蝕證據與控制邊界為主線，從厭氧停留與來源、總硫化物水相負荷、pH 與水相分配、跌水逸散與氣相量測進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops sulfide generation, release, corrosion evidence and control boundaries through ten connected units, beginning with anaerobic retention and sources, total aqueous sulfide load, ph and aqueous speciation, release at drops and gas monitoring. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.title: 總硫化物水相負荷：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Total aqueous sulfide load: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 總硫化物水相負荷 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Total aqueous sulfide load and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先統一硫質量基準，採樣保存不當會讓氧化或揮發被誤認為真去除。
steps.instructionEn: Use a common sulfur-mass basis; poor sample preservation can make oxidation or volatilization appear to be treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：Q=800 m³/d；總溶解硫化物=4 mg S/L。模型 LS=QC/1000，代入得到 3.2 kg S/d。適用邊界：硫基準水相負荷，不是空氣中 H2S 濃度；採樣須避免氧化與揮發損失。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=800 m³/d; total dissolved sulfide=4 mg S/L. Model LS=QC/1000 gives 3.2 kg S/d. Applicability: Aqueous sulfur-basis load, not airborne H2S concentration; sampling must prevent oxidation and volatilization loss.
steps.failure: 硫與 H2S 分子質量混用。診斷與介入：核對保存、氧化及揮發損失，重新建立硫質量基準。
steps.failureEn: Sulfur mass and H2S molecular mass are mixed. Diagnostic response: Check preservation, oxidation and volatilization losses and rebuild the sulfur basis.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「總硫化物水相負荷」的觀測點。採樣保存與分析方法成對記錄，對比流量加權樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for total aqueous sulfide load. Record preservation and analytical methods together and compare flow-weighted samples.
